narrative: On the part. Your cue-strip at the head, in the tiring-house, before the afternoon. The title is the whole of what the strip shows at its top. No book of the play. On the part. The same strip, a run of cues in another hand, none of them a king. The yard is not in the frame. On the part. The strip set on the chest. The afternoon is done. The flag-line is not on the paper.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played in Fair Em and set the strip down after.
